test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

We have / run out eggs; / could you buy / some more?
solution: The erroneous part of the sentence is: **run out eggs** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • We need to add **'of' **after **"run out"** to make the sentence correct. • We use **"of" **when we want to show that people or things relate to other things or people. • **"Run out of"** means to use all of something and not have any left. • **Example-** *Many hospitals have **run out of **oxygen during the covid 19 pandemic.* • The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**Could you buy some more eggs for us because we've no stocks left?"** **​**Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. **Corrected sentence:** *We have **run out of __**eggs; could you buy some more? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** * *​​हमें वाक्य को सही बनाने के लिए "run out" के बाद "of" जोड़ना होगा।* • जब हम दिखाना चाहते हैं कि लोग या चीजें अन्य चीजों या लोगों से संबंधित हैं, तब हम "of" का उपयोग करते हैं। • "Run out of" का अर्थ होता है कि कुछ से सब कुछ उपयोग करके कुछ बचा नहीं होना। • For e.g.- *Many hospitals have run out of oxygen during the covid 19 pandemic.* 37:T7dd, The erroneous part of the sentence is: **more better**
